identity: Martial artist and film actor · United States · 1940–1973
title: Bruce Lee's birth chart
metaDescription: Bruce Lee's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 5.5° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Scorpio — the Moon, Mercury, Venus and Mars. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 5.5° into Sagittarius — the first decan, which the old scheme hands to Jupiter. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 15.4° Scorpio, Venus at 1.6° Scorpio, Mars at 4.7° Scorpio. Mercury in a water sign reads as thought steeped in tone and memory; Venus in a water sign reads as attraction that works by atmosphere; Mars in a water sign reads as effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mars and Pluto — a square holding at 0.5°. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen. Behind it, the Sun trine Pluto at 1.2°, and Jupiter conjunction Saturn at 2.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Venus opposes Jupiter while both square Pluto. Two squares braced against one opposition make a t-square — the chart’s working end, where pressure keeps finding the same outlet.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, three placements stand out. The Moon in Scorpio at 14.4° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Scorpio at 1.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Scorpio at 4.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 4 water, 4 earth, 2 fire; by modality, 8 fixed, 2 mutable. Water weights a chart toward the felt and the remembered — information that arrives as atmosphere before it arrives as words. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Pluto were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.8° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 14.4°.
